reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: Up to EUR 25 million holding level loan to AEREF V PL PRS S.a r.l for financing the development and operation of a pipeline of apartments for rent across Poland. The project is considered under the Resilience and Livelihoods Framework, a EUR 2 billion package which was adopted by the EBRD after the start of the war on Ukraine in order to support Ukraine and other affected countries. The operation will help to improve the housing situation in Poland, which was recently exacerbated by the war on Ukraine and the inflow of Ukrainian refugees to Poland. Currently, the Company operates in Private Rented Sector with 688 units, with the share of Ukrainian tenants standing at 28%. The proceeds from the planned financing will be utilized to finance the development and operation of a portfolio of apartments for rent located across Poland in Warsaw, Krakow, Wroclaw, Gdansk, Lodz and Katowice. The Company aims to grow the platform to the target size of 10,000 operating units.
